eGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval
, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environmen
t suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n-
[Launch one run per target as a group (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-grou
p-async.md): Launches ONE run per target (attached project environments, or attached named hosts) under a single **server-minted**
`runGroupId`, then detaches execution and responds `202` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does n
ot run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eva
l suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to autho
r a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suit
e](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by de
clared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite ha
s no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, opti
onal pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuratio
n.md): The suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run roll
ups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eva
l-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as the
y are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `
[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [List a suite's eval cases](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape
.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Bo
th `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a
case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n- [Creat
e several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the s
uite in one call: the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round
trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually:
a `failed`…\n- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-f
rom-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persist
s them: the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author ev
al cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `c
ases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test
plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls
, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-jo
b.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job o
nce its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unres
olved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl`
for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case
that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields
are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` ac
cept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large
to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` us
es for widget evidence.\n- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-ur
l-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SD
K_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/ev
al-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval i
ngestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported c
apabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advi
sory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project
authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and
its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted infer
ence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running
OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own.
Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately:
the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SD
K suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.\n- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the ru
n stays open in the dashboard.\n- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterat
